data:
PIZZA BALLOON! 

PROS: THE FALL SLOWS DOWN! 
CONS: THE FALL SLOWS DOWN!

EXPLODING SHELL CASINGS! NOW THEY ARE NOT USELESS! EXPLODE BOTH ENEMIES
AND PLATFORMS.
PLATFORMS NOW FIRES A LARGE PROJECTILES WHEN DESTROYED!
LASER SIGHT! NOW YOU SHOOT MORE ACCURATELY AND LESS SPREAD OF PROJECTILES!
DRONE WITH INFINITE AMMO, BUT TRY TO HIT TARGET FIRST...
I'M NOT BOMBED OUT! BUT YOU DO WHEN YOU JUMP. PRETTY BADLY.

ANOTHER BOMB! BUT NOW INSTEAD OF A USELESS SPENT CLIP. TRY TO LOVE HER.
IT'S A STRANGE LOVE.
KIND OF LIKE A SHOTGUN, NOW THE WHOLE CLIP FIRES AT ONCE.

EMBRION.
YOUR STRONG BOND WITH HIM GIVES YOU TWO HEALTH POINTS, AND HE'S ALSO VERY LIGHT.
TRIPLE SHOT! SOMETIMES VERY USEFUL, BUT QUICKLY USES UP THE CLIP.

NOW 
THE ENEMIES EXPLODE WHEN THEY DIE, 
AND THEY FIRE A KILLER BULLET!
NOW THIS DECOMMISSIONED COMBAT SATELLITE FOLLOWS YOU AROUND AND WREAKS HAVOC!
I'M NOT FROM THIS GAME AT ALL...
YOU HAVE ENOUGH SALAMI TO BUY A NEW ITEM
THE TREEHOUSE KEY IS AT THE BOTTOM OF THE PIT, TAKE IT OUT AND YOU WILL GET YOUR INHERITANCE, GRANDSON!
IF IT'S HARD TO PLAY, THIS SHOULD HELP
SHOOT THE TARGET TO GET A NEW ITEM!
